title: EthenaPay Repeat Spending: Wallet Cohorts to Oct 4, 2026
headline: Do EthenaPay wallets keep spending?
name: EthenaPay repeat spending review
description: Of 126 EthenaPay wallets that first spent in the week the beta opened, 89 spent in the week to October 4, four weeks on. Weekly cohorts from a chain recount.
imageAlt: Line chart of the share of EthenaPay wallets spending in each week after their first spend. Wallets that first spent from August 31 to September 27, 80% in week 1 and 71% in week 4. Wallets that first spent from June 4 to August 30, 72% in week 1 and 63% in week 5.
